svg.title: TurkBizTel current Azure architecture, 24 November 2026
svg.desc: Customers, partners and staff access a trusted Container Apps boundary. It alone owns private Blob state and email. Six ingress-free managed-identity bridges invoke six scoped Foundry hosted agents, of which decomposition and fallout use mini and customer update uses nano. Monitoring is Azure Monitor; Agent 365 is a separate unverified integration.

Observed 24 November 2026 | Sweden Central synthetic pilot | Not the proposed Turkish production target

Synthetic pilot only. GlobalStandard is not an EU-only inference guarantee. No Turkish residency, production compliance or Agent 365 governance is claimed.
